name: get_property_details
description: Get comprehensive property details for an address: physical characteristics, features, tax information and history, ownership records, and parcel/legal description.

address.description: Full property address (e.g., '456 Oak Dr, Denver, CO 80202')

name: check_zoning
description: Check zoning for a property: classification code, permitted/conditional/prohibited uses, development standards (height, FAR, setbacks, parking), overlay districts, and development potential (ADU, subdivision).

address.description: Full property address to check zoning for

name: get_tax_assessment
description: Get property tax assessment: land and improvement values, tax rate breakdown by jurisdiction, exemptions, assessment history, appeal information, and payment schedule.

address.description: Full property address to look up tax assessment

name: search_properties
description: Search for property listings matching criteria (price range, beds, baths, zip code, property type). Returns matching listings with summary statistics.

criteria.description: JSON object of search criteria, e.g. '{"min_price": 300000, "max_price": 600000, "beds_min": 3, "baths_min": 2, "zipcode": "78701", "property_type": "single_family"}'
